feeds.title: Olive You Whole Blog
feeds.description: Olive You Whole is a Paleo blog and Whole30 blog dedicated to bringing you clean recipes and natural lifestyle tips! Caroline is the author behind the blog.

feeds.title: Tastes Lovely
feeds.description: I'm Natalie Gruendl, the author, photographer and recipe developer of TastesLovely.com. I love to cook and develop recipes that are nutritious, simple, use fresh ingredients and, of course, taste lovely! Every recipe I post has been made by me at least 3 times to make sure all of the kinks are worked out. I post step-by-step photos to make my recipes easy for you to duplicate and make at home.

feeds.title: nocrumbsleft
feeds.description: Posts about Whole30 written by Teri Turner.

feeds.title: The Whole30 Program
feeds.description: The Whole30 Program has been featured in the New York Times bestselling book, The Whole30. It provides more than 100 totally compliant recipes. Whole30 has been changing lives since 2009 when co-founder Melissa Hartwig blogged about a 30-day life-changing dietary experiment she recently completed.

feeds.title: A Saucy Kitchen » Whole30
feeds.description: You don't have to be in the middle of a Whole30 journey to enjoy these healthy and delicious recipes. Everything you find here will be gluten, grain, sugar, soy, dairy, and legume-free so you can fill up on just the good stuff! Authored by Sarah Nevins.

feeds.title: Mel Joulwan : Well Fed
feeds.description: I like to experiment on myself, then tell you all about the things I learn. Just about everything is fair game: new training programs and workout gear, paleo recipes, Whole30 recipes unusual ingredients, cooking techniques, meditation and yoga, books, art, movies, sports... and, of course, photos of my cat Smudge.

feeds.title: Against All Grain
feeds.description: Author of the New York Times Best Selling cookbook , Danielle Walker provides recipes that are grain-free, Whole 30, refined sugar-free, and lactose-free. Perfect for Paleo, Gluten-Free, SCD, and GAPS.

feeds.title: Loubies and Lulu
feeds.description: Welcome to the Whole30 section of my blog! Scroll down to find all of the posts from my Whole30 wellness journey over the past few years. I embarked on my first Whole30 in March 2013. I was reluctant to try it, but I'm so thankful I did because it completely changed my relationship with food.

feeds.title: The Paleo Running Momma
feeds.description: I'm a Paleo recipe creator, blogger and photographer who also happens to love running! My recipes range from strict Whole30 to decadent 'technically Paleo' desserts that everyone will love. I believe that everyone should give real food a chance - it's definitely worth it, no matter who you are and what your goals.

feeds.title: Pretend it's a Donut
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Jen and I live in the bay area with my hunk of a husband, my 5 kids, and a very boisterous boxer. Mostly paleo, sometimes whole30….the recipes on here are quite scrumptious and my family eats all of it! Enjoy this tasty little morsel of a blog!

feeds.title: Mind Over Munch » Whole30
feeds.description: Stay up on the latest Whole30 recipes by Alyssia Sheikh. Mind Over Munch is your all-encompassing resource for food, health, fun, and a community built around encouragement, passion, and positivity.

feeds.title: Cook Eat Well » Whole30 Recipes
feeds.description: Covers Whole30 Recipes written by Lisa Wells. If you're looking for easy ways to make healthy eating and living well a part of your lifestyle - without giving up all the foods you love or spending hours in the kitchen - you're in the right place.

feeds.title: little coconutty
feeds.description: Whole30 recipes and tips to get you through a whole30 challenge along with Paleo recipes and all things eating clean.

feeds.title: Whole30 Recipe Exchange
feeds.description: An Index of Links for Whole30 recipes that have been tried and recommended by others on Whole30. Strict Whole30 here, all are good! Modifications are noted in the Index as needed.

feeds.title: Zippity Do Dah! Healthy Eating!
feeds.description: I'm a Foodie! I love learning, but more importantly, I love sharing healthy recipes that are either Paleo, Primal, or Whole30 related. This blog, however, contains only Whole30 compliant recipes.

feeds.title: Eat the Gains
feeds.description: Welcome! I'm Kelly, a food and fitness lover. I like to create healthy recipes that help fuel my workouts and make my body feel good inside & out.

feeds.title: Whole Kitchen Sink » Whole30 Recipes
feeds.description: Healthy Whole30 recipes are easy and family-friendly. Authored by Bailey. She shares healthy Paleo and Whole30 recipes that have helped her lose 120 pounds.
